text: I'm fostering a little boy, 17 months, and I'm a bit shaken. About an hour ago he ran into the corner of the coffee table and banged his forehead. He screamed straight away, poor thing, but he's been totally himself since, playing with his cars and eating his snack like nothing happened. Also his eye has gone pink and gunky, the lashes were stuck together after his nap. And his cheeks are bright red, which scared me at first, but they went like that after we were out at the park in that freezing wind and they're already fading now he's warm indoors. I just really don't want to get anything wrong with him. Is there anything I should be watching for tonight with the head bump?
